ttl.name: Front Door Belt Moulding Assembly LH

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Inside Handle Bezel LH

s2.ptxt: Using a screwdriver with its tip wrapped in protective tape, disengage the 3 claws and remove the front door inside handle bezel RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Door Assist Grip Cover LH

s2.ptxt: Using a screwdriver with its tip wrapped in protective tape, disengage the 4 claws and remove the door assist grip cover RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Trim Board Sub-assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Using a clip remover, disengage the 9 clips of the front door trim board RH.
Disengage the 4 claws and disconnect the front door trim board RH from the front door glass weatherstrip inner RH.
Disengage the 2 claws and remove the front door trim board RH from the front door inside handle RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Inside Handle Sub-assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the front door lock remote control cable RH and front door inside locking cable RH, and remove the front door inside handle RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Glass Weatherstrip Inner LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the front door glass weatherstrip inner RH from the front door panel.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Service Hole Cover LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the front door service hole cover RH.

atten3.ptxt: Remove any butyl tape remaining on the door panel side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Glass Sub-assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Connect the battery negative terminal and power window regulator master switch assembly, and move the front door glass RH to a position where the front door glass RH installation bolts are visible.
Disconnect the battery negative terminal and power window regulator master switch assembly.
Remove the front door glass RH in the order shown in the illustration.

atten3.ptxt: Do not damage the front door glass RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Belt Moulding Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Apply protective tape to the body surface below the front door belt moulding assembly LH.
Using a screwdriver with its tip wrapped in protective tape, disengage the 6 claws from the inside of the door and remove the front door belt moulding assembly LH.
